This list is updated automatically from the [HAL open archive](https://cv.hal.science/gfaraut),
where most papers can be downloaded freely, and from [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org) for the
most recent ones. See also my
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0388-932X) record.

::: {.dora-note}
**On research assessment.** In line with the
[San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA)](https://sfdora.org/read/), signed by
[Université Paris-Saclay](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/actualites/luniversite-paris-saclay-signataire-de-dora)
in 2022, this site shows no journal-based metrics (impact factors, journal rankings) nor
citation counts: each work should be judged on its own content. The main contribution of
selected papers is summarized on the [Research](research.qmd) page.
:::
